canon.note: Pearl is an Elation-path Ice healer/support (Energy limit 180). Basic 150301 Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream is a %DEF Ice hit. Skill 150302 Relume Life's Light spends 1 SP, +30 Energy, gains +15 Certified Banger and heals the team (+ the lowest-HP ally again). Ultimate 150303 Appraise Soul's Ground gains +20 CB and marks the team's Elation Archetype with Deep Learning, advancing them. Talent Grow Grace from Grit turns CB into Repellency (200/CB, cap 50) which absorbs 60% incoming ally DMG; an ally at <=50% HP additionally takes -30%. A0 Panoptic Vision (DEF>=2400) adds Elation and an OHB bonus; A2 Sensory Latitude gives +5 CB at each ally turn start.

requirements.claim: Talent 'Grow Grace from Grit': incoming damage to a ≤50% HP ally is intercepted by Repellency — logged 'Pearl Repellency blocks' (elation.ts:610-631).
Basic ATK 150301 Brushstroke: Trace the Severed Stream is a single Ice hit (scaled on DEF).
Relume Life's Light (150302) is Pearl's Skill action.
Appraise Soul's Ground (150303) is Pearl's Ultimate action.
The Ultimate marks the Elation Archetype (Hook) with Deep Learning (pearl_deep).
After the Archetype Basic, Deep Learning enhances Pearl's Basic to Brushstroke: Render the Great Wave (non-Elation archetype).
Deep Learning adds Ice Elation DMG owned by the Archetype (Hook).
A0 Panoptic Vision grants Pearl an OHB bonus buff (pearl_a0_ohb).
A2 Sensory Latitude fires on an ally turn start, granting Effect RES +50% (pearl_a2) while Pearl holds CB.
E6 Compute Life From One Shell grants all allies All-Type RES PEN +20% while Deep Learning is up (pearl_e6).
Deep Learning is applied (Ultimate) before its enhanced hits resolve.
Pearl's Ultimate gate is the 180-Energy ladder; she never exceeds it.
